Self-Evolved Reward Learning (SER) proposes an approach to reward model (RM) training in RLHF that addresses the cost and potential biases associated with relying solely on human-annotated data [2411.00418].

Specifically, SER enables the reward model to generate additional training data itself, which is then used to iteratively improve its own performance [2411.00418]. By incorporating this "self-feedback," the model can robustly enhance its performance even when the initial amount of human-annotated data is limited, ultimately leading to improved capabilities in the language models being aligned [2411.00418].
